per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: MIC/MBC database rows that match Tables 1/2 are source_verified; hemolysis exact bins and PLpro rows with infection/target wording conflicts remain source_conflict with locators and caution context.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to direct PLpro enzyme inhibition, model-vesicle leakage, CD membrane-context evidence, and phenotype-level antibacterial activity without overclaiming an intact-cell molecular target.
